people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
translations.bsb: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul; you must stand before Caesar. And look, God has granted you the lives of all who sail with you.’
translations.kjv: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
translations.asv: saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must stand before Caesar: and lo, God hath granted thee all them that sail with thee.
